items.title: Forsaken Cities
items.placementTarget: Rulebook page 6, slot A (under the population ladder, before Supply Lines)
items.text:
FORSAKEN CITIES
Cities with a population of zero ([0 in a red square]) have the following effects:
• While in a forsaken city, you may do only the Drive/Ferry action and may not do any free actions.
• When you draw an Infection card for a forsaken city for any reason, place it into the Game End area (ignoring it completely) and draw a replacement card.
• Forsaken cities do not count as cities on the grid when determining Game End Production.
• You may increase the population of a forsaken city. The cost to restore it to a population of 1 is [2 in a yellow circle].
• Forsaken cities are immediately infested. Open Door [50 in a red box] if you have not done so and immediately mark all forsaken cities with an Infested sticker.

rules: A forsaken city is a city at population 0.
In a forsaken city the only legal action is Drive/Ferry. Free actions are illegal there.
An Infection card drawn for a forsaken city, for any reason, goes to the Game End area and is ignored. Draw a replacement.
Forsaken cities are not cities on the grid for Game End Production.
Restoring a forsaken city to population 1 costs 2, printed as a numeral 2 in a yellow circle. The sticker does not name the resource.
A city becomes infested the moment it is forsaken. Stick an Infested sticker on every forsaken city.
mechanics.effect: Defines population-0 cities and instructs you to open Door 50 if it is still closed.

summary: Forsaken cities (population 0) restrict actions, skip infection, drop out of Game End Production, cost 2 to restore, and are immediately infested. Opens Door 50.
